title: The Town Where Temperature Jumped 49 Degrees in 2 Minutes

scenes.text: In two minutes, the temperature jumped 49 degrees.
Spearfish, South Dakota, January 22nd, 1943. It was minus four degrees Fahrenheit at 7:30 in the morning.
Then a warm wind called a chinook arrived. Two minutes later, it was 45 degrees.
Windows cracked from the sudden change.
Then it crashed back to minus four.
The fastest temperature change ever recorded. Forty-nine degrees in two minutes.

description:
On January 22nd, 1943, Spearfish, South Dakota went from minus 4 to 45 degrees Fahrenheit in two minutes.
Windows cracked, and it later fell back to minus 4.
Could you handle weather that fast?
